title: Jadeveon Clowney glad to play for DeMeco Ryans in Houston after clashing with Bill O'Brien

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jadeveon Clowney glad to play for DeMeco Ryans in Houston after clashing with Bill O'Brien
sources.description: "I take nothing personally," Clowney said. "I don't have hard feelings. It was just O'Brien at the time, me and him bumped heads."
